title: CareSmartz360 component contract
description: Machine-readable half of a component contract. Its whole purpose is that every published value carries PROVENANCE, so drift is caught by a script instead of by eye, and so a derived value can never be mistaken for a measured one. A value object without a `marker` is invalid by design.

$meta.description: Provenance for the contract as a whole. Deliberately strict: a contract that cannot say WHERE and WHEN it was measured is not evidence.

figmaFileKeyProvenance.description: REQUIRED because the Figma desktop MCP serves whatever tab is active and never reports a file key. If the key was not measured, this field must say so.

nodeIdRelationship.description: When both a section and a component-set id are recorded, state which is which. A section CONTAINS a set; they are not alternatives.

readThisFirst.description: REQUIRED. Any known way this component's own Figma documentation contradicts the file, so a reader is warned before trusting prose over bound variables.

geometry.description: Every leaf that carries a design value SHOULD be a valueWithProvenance. A bare number is not publishable.

alphaIsLoadBearing.description: Present whenever any bound colour has alpha < 1. A pipeline reading only the `hex` field silently flattens translucency — this is the field that warns it.

namingException.description: Where the formula does NOT hold. A formula published without its exceptions is a trap for code generators.

notVerified.description: REQUIRED, and an empty array is a strong claim. Anything not read goes here rather than being filled with a plausible value.

untilApproved.description: What a reader may and may not do while the decision is open. Recording a RAW value is not permission to hardcode it.

required_note: notVerified is required in practice; see allOf below.

allOf.description: A contract must declare what it did NOT verify.

nodeId.description: Real Figma node ids are not uniform. Round-hundred ids such as 1:100 are the fabrication signature this repo has already been burned by.

marker.description: MEASURED = read from live Figma. DERIVED = computed from measured values, arithmetic shown in the .md. RAW = real value but bound to no token. UNVERIFIED = not read. MEASURED and UNVERIFIED are mutually exclusive.

token.description: null means genuinely unbound — a design-system gap, not an omission.

allOf.description: A RAW value must not claim a token.
A value cannot be MEASURED and UNVERIFIED at once.

hover.description: null is a MEASURED ABSENCE — the set does not bind it. Not 'unknown'.
